heading: Interagency data standardization
lead: Not later than 30 months after April 29, 2022, the Secretaries shall jointly develop and adopt interagency standards to ensure compatibility and interoperability among applicable Federal databases with respect to the collection and dissemination of data—

tree.text: relating to recreation sites on Federal land; and
used to depict locations at which recreation uses are available to the public.

notes.text: Amendments2025—Par. (1). Pub. L. 118–234 substituted “recreation sites” for “public outdoor recreational use”.
